coordinateConvention: glTF local character space before website normalization; quaternions xyzw.

exportSummary.pitchPolicy: 15 extra samples = RifleAimingIdle / FiringRifle / ShotgunPump at normalized pitch -1,-0.5,0,0.5,1. The zero-pitch variants overlap existing level actions; these are not 15 new authored motions.

limitations: Pistol Run and Reloading use the unchanged original generic RifleRun/Reloading clips and original QSZ92 hand-to-gun calibration; these are not native pistol-specific clips. No detachable magazine or shell prop animation is authored. M870 keeps original M97 Fire/Pump/Reload body, wrist and finger motion; only the support palm moves down 30 mm and the pump amplitude becomes 75 mm.

Original baseline runtime chest relief is unchanged. Skeleton animation alone does not store dynamic mesh weights: apply the original relief weights in chest_skinning.json for M870 RifleIdle/RifleWalk only, restore source weights otherwise. No source character geometry or skin weights were overwritten.
